description: The crashlog base URLs (production, staging, local dev collector) and the debug-only staging switch exist once per shell, because each reads its own preference store and each debug build reaches localhost differently (browser localhost, simulator localhost, emulator 10.0.2.2).
note: Change a host in all three copies in one commit. Release builds must always resolve to production; only debug/dev builds may select local or staging. Deliberately NOT generated: these are deployment constants that change about never, so a generator plus its gate would cost more than the drift it prevents.
